title: sp-5.2: the key `strokes.count` counts `stroke`, its recipes name `stroke-1`, `stroke-2`, `stroke-3`
text: `state_keys.strokes.count` is `{kind: count, actors: [stroke], expect: rises}` and the story point's recipes name three props, `stroke-1` to `stroke-3`. `read_count` reads `present(rec, 'stroke', f)`, so the blocking would need a fourth prop called `stroke` for the key to pass. `probe-story.py` now reads a bare name as a family (`present_family`: `stroke` is present when `stroke` or any `stroke-<n>` is), with its own control (a count over `stroke` passes with the three on, `ghost` and `strok` do not). That makes the key pass on the three strokes the story point draws; the alternative is to edit the key to name the three props, which is the screenplay's.
after: pass on the three numbered strokes
